snippet.title: Cronos: The New Dawn - Survive the Nest | Xbox Games Showcase 2025
snippet.description:
Watch the Official Gameplay showcase for Cronos: The New Dawn, a pulse-pounding, third-person survival horror game by Bloober Team!

In the time-warped nightmare of the future, monsters known as Orphans stalk the land. Emerging from the downfall of mankind, these grotesque creatures can fuse together to create even deadlier foes. 

In this gameplay showcase, you will witness the Traveler descending into an Orphan nest, confronting the twisted creatures that inhabit its depths.

https://www.xbox.com/games/store/cronos-the-new-dawn/9P7TFLQ7CTXN?msockid=17deed0d178b66c60497f9da16316706

Discover the endless adventures you can unlock with Xbox Series X|S. Shop Now: https://www.xbox.com/consoles
